newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Pharmacia & Upjohn to invest 1.4bln bfr in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn to invest 1.4bln bfr in Belgium.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Friday it would invest 1.4 billion francs to prepare its Belgian department for hypodermic drugs for the 21st century.

The investment involves the construction of a 5,000 square metre, three-storey building at its Puurs location for integrated and automated drug production and packaging. The new facility is due to come on stream by the end of 1998.

In Puurs, north of Brussels, Pharmacia & Upjohn also has a distribution centre. Together with a marketing organisation in Brussels, the company employs 1,014 people in Belgium and had turnover of 12.9 billion Belgian francs.
Puurs exports 94 percent of its output.
Pharmacia & Upjohn sold 3.4 billion francs worth of human medication in 1996, making the number three drug selling firm in Belgium.
